spec.kitLine: start of battle; Dmg to Parts 24.26%/15s
spec.assertion: buffApply stat partsDamagePct value 24.26 covers every comp slug; proves ally-wide scope. Fails under self-only/excludeSelf scoping. Paired inertness run boosts it 400x and requires all four totals byte-identical — fails if the line was smuggled into a live bucket (attackDamagePct/trueDamagePct).

requires >= 2 applications per ally, i.e. both slots encoded. Fails under a merged single-source encoding (one apply per ally). Bookkeeping/no-silent-drop check — partsDamagePct moves no damage either way.

it.skip for the payload (no part-destruction TriggerDef primitive; partless scope-lock boss). Live guard: zero casterAtkPct/atkPct/highestAllyAtkPct buffApply events carrying HER casterIdx (identified via her unique 24.26% parts applies). Fails if the stack line was proxied to fullBurstEnter/hitCount/passive-at-cap — the over-credit failure mode.

Tick count measured as the damage-event-count delta vs a DoT-removed clone (slot-attribution free): 100 <= ticks <= 200 over the 180s sim. RED under nearest-wrong #1 (one-shot 15s instance, ~15 ticks) and nearest-wrong #2 (repeating trigger x 15s duration multiplying instances, many hundreds). Also: her total drops >1% without it while teammate totals stay byte-identical (correct owner, not ally-wide).

Cross-line: boosting her burst's sustainedDamagePct to 400 raises HER total >1%. The comp's only sustained-flavored damage is this DoT and its only sustained buff is her burst, so the pair is self-discriminating. Fails if the DoT is written with no flavor or a wrong flavor ('true'/'distributed').

buffApply with stat damageTakenPct value 32.23 and casterIdx === null AND targetIdx === null (boss-held); removing it lowers EVERY ally's total. Fails under the taxonomy-4 misread (treated as a self/ally offensive buff), where only one row moves and the event carries real indices.

raw-percentage buffApply (20.32, not flat-resolved) covering all four allies; boosting it to 400 leaves every teammate within 0.1% (scope really is sustained-only). Fails if encoded as generic attackDamagePct, which would lift liter/crown/helm.
Stretching durationSec 10 -> 120 must INCREASE her total (more sustained-boosted DoT ticks). Fails under a permanent (durationSec-absent) encoding, where imposing a window cannot increase damage.

Requires >=1 damageTakenPct(32.23) and >=1 sustainedDamagePct(20.32) apply in the base run. She shares stage 2 with crown, so a RED here localizes the failure to the FIXTURE (she never bursts) rather than to the burst model — without it every burst assertion above could pass vacuously.

fixtures: Single fixture: controlComp('rosanna-chic-ocean', true) — liter (B1) / crown (B2) / carry / helm (B3), deterministic, no seed. helm=true is required: the chain needs a Burst III to reach Full Burst, and rosanna-chic-ocean is Burst II (helm=false would leave B1+B2+B2 = zero Full Bursts). Because she is Burst II she competes with crown for stage 2, so an explicit non-vacuity test asserts her burst really casts before the burst-slot assertions are trusted. 6 hoisted 180s runs: base + 5 withPatchedOverride counterfactuals (parts boosted 400x, DoT removed, damageTakenPct removed, sustainedDamagePct boosted to 400, sustainedDamagePct durationSec 10->120). Slot-shape helper reads both documented override slot shapes (bare Block[] and CharacterSkills.blocks) and mutates in place. NOTE: I was invoked with no tool access, so the source could not be written to scripts/kit-autonomy/blind/rosanna-chic-ocean.test.ts or the spec JSON to scripts/kit-autonomy/blind/rosanna-chic-ocean.test-spec.json — both are returned inline here for the orchestrator to persist.
gaps: skill1 #2 "ATK ▲ 3% of the skill user's ATK, stacks up to 5, 30 sec" — it.skip: the activation clause is "when an ally or self destroys an enemy's part"; TriggerDef has no part-destruction primitive AND the scope-lock boss is partless, so the trigger is unreachable and the payload unobservable. Correct handling is `unmodeled` text; a live-trigger proxy is asserted AGAINST rather than skipped.

⚑ skill2 #2 re-fire cadence: the kit gives the DoT no activation clause, so the interval that maintains it (skill cooldown) is outside the input domain. The test therefore asserts only what the prose pins — 1 tick/sec, maintained through the fight, non-multiplying (100–200 ticks) — and deliberately does NOT assert a specific first-fire phase (t=0 passive vs t=CD interval), which differ by ~15 ticks.
partsDamagePct (both 24.26% lines) is parsed-but-inert in v1: kept for completeness and asserted INERT. Its real magnitude/scope cannot be graded on a partless boss.
